newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai interbank rate eases, baht firms late.
newsitem.headline: Thai interbank rate eases, baht firms late.

text.p: The Thai overnight interbank rate continued to ease near the Thursday close on sustained fair liquidity after the New Year holiday, dealers said.
They said the overnight rate fell to 12.00-13.00 percent in late activities from 13.50 in the morning.
Dealers were divided over the short-term money market outlook next week. Some expected steady interbank rates due to the January 7 bank cash reserve deadline but others see them easing further.
"It is likely the overnight rate will ease further. Money withdrawn before New Year should flow back into the system soon, pulling rates down," a dealer at Thai Farmers Bank said.
The baht firmed to 25.628/25.635 to the dollar late in the session against 25.633/25.638 in the morning as local dollar buying slowed in the afternoon.
The bid/offer range of the one-month dollar/baht swap premium eased to 9.30/10.30 satangs per dollar from 9.50/10.50 in the morning.
The central bank fixed the dollar/baht midrate at 25.60 against 25.61 on Monday. -- Anchalee Koetsawang (662) 652-0642
